ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a transition-state structure containing curved arrows; the top is labeled with an OEt substituent, and the central carbon is simultaneously connected to a C(O) fragment related to a hydroxyl group; the structure has a segment of C=C skeleton, the carbon on the right has a methyl branch, and is connected to phenyl through C=N. The curved arrows in the figure only indicate electron movement, and the problem requires ignoring them. Reasoning: According to the specified method, transcribe starting from the OEt end as CCO, and let it connect to the central alkenyl carbon, obtaining CCO/C(O). This central carbon bears OH and forms a double bond with the adjacent carbon, written as /C(O)=C; continue to the carbon bearing a methyl branch and connect to the imine nitrogen, written as C(C)=N; the nitrogen is then connected to phenyl, written as /c1ccccc1. Combine and retain the slash stereochemical markers shown in the figure, obtaining CCO/C(O)=CC(C)=N/c1ccccc1.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: Ignore all curved arrows, then transcribe the depicted transition-state structure atom by atom. Start from the ethoxy substituent labeled OEt and write it as CCO attached to the central vinylic carbon. Add the central carbon bearing OH as /C(O), connect it by a double bond to the adjacent carbon, continue to the carbon bearing a methyl branch, then encode the imine linkage to the phenyl ring as C(C)=N/c1ccccc1. Combine these fragments with the stereochemical slash notation indicated by the drawing to obtain CCO/C(O)=CC(C)=N/c1ccccc1.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个含弯曲箭头的过渡态结构；顶部标有 OEt 取代基，中心碳同时与羟基相关的 C(O) 片段相连；结构中有一段 C=C 骨架，右侧碳带有甲基支链，并通过 C=N 与苯基相连。图中的弯曲箭头只表示电子移动，题目要求忽略。推理：按指定方法从 OEt 端开始转写为 CCO，并让其连接到中心烯基碳，得到 CCO/C(O)。该中心碳带 OH 并与相邻碳成双键，写作 /C(O)=C；继续到带甲基支链的碳并接亚胺氮，写作 C(C)=N；氮再连到苯基，写作 /c1ccccc1。合并并保留图示的斜杠立体标记，得到 CCO/C(O)=CC(C)=N/c1ccccc1。

planner_metadata.image_role: First describe the image: identify the drawn molecule while ignoring the curved reaction arrows. Read the visible phenyl ring attached to an imine nitrogen, the conjugated chain containing N=C-C=C, the methyl substituent on the imine carbon, the hydroxyl group labeled HO, and the ethoxy group labeled OEt attached through oxygen at the top.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text only to determine the required output format: a SMILES expression for the shown transition-state structure, and to explicitly ignore the arrows.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use organic skeletal notation and SMILES rules: expand OEt as CCO, encode phenyl as c1ccccc1, represent hydroxyl as a branch C(O), represent methyl as C(C), represent the imine as C=N, and preserve the drawn alkene/imine stereochemical orientation with slash bonds where applicable.
